 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    two = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if len(one) != 1 or len(two) != 1:
        return out
    r, c = one[0]
    tr, tc = two[0]
    dr, dc = tr - r, tc - c
    sr = (dr > 0) - (dr < 0)
    sc = (dc > 0) - (dc < 0)
    diagonal_steps = max(0, min(abs(dr), abs(dc)) - 1)
    for _ in range(diagonal_steps):
        r += sr
        c += sc
        if out[r][c] == 0:
            out[r][c] = 3
    if abs(dr) > abs(dc):
        while r != tr - sr:
            r += sr
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 3
    else:
        while c != tc - sc:
            c += sc
            if out[r][c] == 0:
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
